intro.text: Silence's grandmother, remembered by Silence in a conversation about their journey from Homeland.
A woman from the Homeland who travelled to the Forests of Hell on Threnody and raised her granddaughter Silence.

items.text: She and her husband were among the first to reach the continent of the Forests of Hell, which earned them the name Forescout, and after the Homeland fell they ran a waystop. They brought up their granddaughter Silence to be strong.
She taught Silence the Simple Rules for surviving the forest.
Her shade, shut behind a door at the waystop, burst out when Theopolis drew Silence's blood. It killed him and then let Silence lock it away again.
